about: benchmark-v2 labels: the truth label and oracle predicate of every generated case of every frozen RigorRun-mode case, written before any benchmark-v2 run from the playbooks, the frozen case files and the suites the product under test generated at setup. See PREREGISTRATION.md.
predicateScope: A predicate sees `before` and `after` (the oracle readings at the start and end of the generated case's window) and `new` and `removed` (GreenMail: messages added and taken away, counted as multisets). SQLite predicates are the frozen v1 `expect`, which reads before/after tables.

case_live__happy_path.rationale: Injected fault. The fault proxy (FAULT_DROP_TOOL=send_email, FAULT_DROP_NTH=1) swallows the response to the first send_email its process sees. One connector process serves every case of a run (packages/daemon/src/workspace.ts:257-258) and happy_path runs first, so this send's response is lost and the playbook's retry delivers a second message.

case_live__unknown_id__service.rationale: Not injected: the proxy's counter was spent by the first case, so this send's response is not dropped and there is no retry. The playbook sends through service "default" whatever the work order names (scripts/playbooks/gm-retry-after-lost-response.json), so it delivers one message although this case's work order names service Record1-DOES-NOT-EXIST; a correct agent sends nothing.
